primary_objective: Debris detection via radar for space situational awareness
payload_requirements: Detect debris objects with radar cross-section >= 10cm² at 500km range
Radar operation in X-band (9.5-10.5 GHz) frequency
Onboard signal processing capability for real-time detection
Data downlink via S-band TT&C subsystem
Minimum 4 radar observation passes per day
Target tracking accuracy of 100m position, 10m/s velocity
operational_requirements: Autonomous operation capability for up to 48 hours
Ground station contact minimum twice per day
Data storage for minimum 24 hours of observations
environmental_requirements: Survive launch vibration loads per GEVS
interface_requirements: Power interface via spacecraft bus 28V unregulated
Data interface via SpaceWire or CAN bus
